metadata.homeDescription: Plan corporate events, conferences, exhibitions and MICE programmes across Morocco with one coordinated local team.
metadata.homeOgTitle: Corporate events in Morocco, thoughtfully delivered
metadata.homeOgDescription: Event planning, production, venues and on-site logistics for organizations meeting in Morocco.

home.title: We create moments, not just events.
home.lead: Event design, planning and production in Morocco.
home.imageAlt: A contemporary conference audience seated beneath warm architectural lighting
home.proofTitle: A clear plan. A calm event day.
home.proofBody: From the first venue shortlist to the last supplier hand-off, we connect planning, production and guest logistics in one working plan. Scope is shaped around your objectives, audience and city.
home.proofNote: No standard package. A clear plan for the event you are actually organizing.
home.expertiseTitle: The event, and everything around it.
home.expertiseBody: One team can coordinate the practical details across suppliers, venues and production partners, so your internal team can stay focused on the purpose of the gathering.
home.eventExpertiseTitle: Events that serve a business purpose.
home.eventExpertiseBody: Considered formats, connected to your objectives and the needs of your audience.
home.miceExpertiseBody: Local logistics planned around the programme, the people attending and your organization’s requirements.
home.destinationsTitle: A city choice shaped by the brief.
home.destinationsBody: We support events in Morocco’s main business and meeting destinations. The right location follows your audience, access, venue needs and programme.
home.projectsBody: The work is planned as a connected delivery system: decisions are documented, vendors receive one clear brief, and on-site teams know who owns the next step.

trustItems.title: One accountable lead
trustItems.body: A clear day-to-day contact keeps decisions, suppliers and internal stakeholders aligned.

trustItems.title: Practical local knowledge
trustItems.body: Venue, access and production choices are evaluated against the real needs of your programme.

trustItems.title: Joined-up delivery
trustItems.body: Planning, technical production and guest logistics sit in one shared run of show.

home.insightsTitle: Start with the decisions that matter.
home.insightsBody: A good first conversation clarifies the objective, audience, city, dates and level of support required. From there, we can build a useful proposal rather than a generic package.
home.ctaTitle: Let’s shape a workable event plan.
home.ctaBody: Share the brief, even if some details are still open. We’ll come back with the questions and next steps needed to scope it properly.
home.honesty: Project stories and client endorsements are published only when their details have been approved.

footer.statement: Corporate events and MICE, coordinated across Morocco.

page.ctaTitle: A clear brief makes a stronger plan.
page.ctaText: Tell us what you know so far. We’ll help define the scope, city and next decision.
page.formBody: Email us directly with your dates, city and the outline of your event.

steps.title: Define the brief
steps.body: Agree the purpose, audience, scope, decision owners and success measures.

steps.title: Build the delivery plan
steps.body: Map the venue, suppliers, production, guest journey, timing and budget dependencies.

steps.title: Coordinate on site
steps.body: Keep one run of show and a clear escalation path from setup through close.

page.portfolioNote: The public case-study library is being prepared. We publish project detail only after client approval; share your brief and we can discuss relevant experience directly.
page.venuesNote: This is a venue-sourcing service, not a live inventory. Venue facilities, capacities, accessibility and availability are confirmed against each proposal before they are shared.

hero.title: The art of
hero.lead: Bespoke experiences in the heart of the Sahara and Atlantic coast. Weddings, galas and launches — every detail is a signature.

services.title: Exceptional weddings
services.lead: Intimate or grand ceremonies between golden dunes and the ocean. Every wedding is entirely unique.
services.detail: From Atlantic beaches to Berber tents beneath the stars, we create weddings that tell your story. Bespoke florals, fine dining and day-of coordination — every detail is considered to make the day unforgettable.

services.title: Galas & private evenings
services.lead: Evenings that stay with people. Scenography, entertainment and gastronomy — all orchestrated.
services.detail: Our galas combine refinement with spectacle. Exclusive themes, international artists, cinematic staging and menus created by acclaimed chefs make a complete sensory experience for your most discerning guests.

services.title: Corporate events
services.lead: Product launches, incentives, seminars, conferences and congresses. Excellence in service of your brand.
services.detail: We turn business objectives into memorable experiences. Team building in the desert, conferences by the ocean and spectacular launches — Morocco’s landscapes amplify the impact of every event.

services.title: Sporting events
services.lead: Competitions, ceremonies, fan zones and sporting experiences designed to bring audiences together.
services.detail: We coordinate the site, teams, partners, signage and spectator experience for sporting events that are fluid, visible and memorable — from a private tournament to a major branded occasion.

services.title: Technical production
services.lead: Sound, LED screens, structures, staging, lighting, show control, photography, video and streaming.
services.detail: Our technical team deploys professional equipment of the latest generation: line-array sound systems, high-resolution LED walls, architectural and stage lighting, bespoke structures, multi-camera video control and live streaming.

expertise.title: Full production
expertise.text: From creative concept to final execution, we manage the complete event production chain with exacting care.

expertise.title: International logistics
expertise.text: Multi-country coordination, transport, accommodation and visas — every logistical detail for guests from around the world.

expertise.title: Immersive scenography
expertise.text: Our creative directors build unique sensory worlds that combine light, sound, set design and technology.

expertise.title: VIP coordination
expertise.text: Personalised hosting, bespoke protocol and private concierge support for every distinguished guest.

dakhla.galleryIntro: Every event is a unique creation. Discover a selection of our most memorable work, from the Sahara to the Atlantic coast.

paragraphs: For more than a decade, 79events has turned each project into an unforgettable experience in Morocco. Our intimate knowledge of the territory, combined with an international partner network, lets us create events that meet the highest expectations.
Every project is a close collaboration with our clients — luxury brands, royal families and Fortune 500 companies — to shape moments that rise above the ordinary.

Our multidisciplinary team — designers, scenographers, artistic directors and field coordinators — works as one to orchestrate every detail. From the first concept to final delivery, we protect the quality of the execution and the experience for every guest.

dakhla.reachIntro: We combine international quality standards with deep knowledge of Morocco, giving clients the best of both worlds.

reach.title: International reach
reach.text: Partners and suppliers across four continents for events without borders.

reach.title: European standards
reach.text: Quality, safety and insurance standards aligned with international requirements.

reach.title: Local excellence
reach.text: Deep local knowledge, skilled artisans and the living expertise of the Sahara.

reach.title: Multilingual service
reach.text: French-, English- and Arabic-speaking teams for clear communication.

dakhla.contactBody: Tell us your date, city and the broad idea for your event. Our 79events team will get back to you.
